claims.statement: For every finite-depth Boolean modulation hierarchy formed by adjoining fresh disjoint blocks Z_l and replacing every older sign u_i by u_i h_{l,i}(Z_l), querying the newest whole block is proper, has collision mixing term M=0, and has entropy decrement sum_S fhat_{l-1}(S)^2 H(h_{l,S}) with queried influence sum_S fhat_{l-1}(S)^2 I(h_{l,S}). If the base and all occupied auxiliary products obey FEI with constants uniformly bounded by C, then the hierarchy obeys H<=C I with the base entropy retained as terminal debt. Taking all modulators equal to a point defect gives a nonlinear arbitrary-depth subclass with auxiliary constant at most 9/2.
claims.quantifiers: All finite depths L; all nonempty finite base cubes; all fresh finite pairwise-disjoint physical blocks; all genuine Boolean bases and modulators satisfying the displayed auxiliary-product premise.
scope_exclusions: Not a proof of full FEI.
Not an existential proper-block theorem for arbitrary Boolean functions.
Does not cover bent-splice branches with unequal squared spectra.
Does not infer an infinite-dimensional theorem from the finite checker.
Does not assume that the unknown fixed-root ratio is universal.
